bio.text: Jim Petty was elected to the Arkansas Senate in 2022; he represents District 29, which includes Crawford County and parts of Washington County.
He is a small business owner and a CPA, and is on the executive leadership team of a multi-state real estate firm.
He and his wife, Janet, have lived in Van Buren for over 26 years.

sources.title: Biography of THE HONORABLE JIM PETTY
